datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC phase classifications were compiled into medium-term projections for Rwanda at quarterly intervals (January, April, July, October 2014), capturing spatial variation in food insecurity severity across administrative units.
